h2: Visual testing in Philadelphia: how VT certification works and where VT inspection fits
html:
Visual testing in Philadelphia: how VT certification works and where VT inspection fits

In Pennsylvania, as elsewhere in the US, VT certification is issued by the technician's employer under its SNT-TC-1A written practice once training, experience and examinations are complete. Atlantis teaches visual testing Level I and Level II theory online with a practical examination and supports Philadelphia employers through its local training page. For VT inspection, Atlantis mobilises crews to Philadelphia-area sites.

The steps to VT certification under an employer's written practice:

  • Classroom training in the method, which the visual testing course provides online.
  • Documented experience hours in VT, logged against real work and signed by the employer.
  • General, specific and practical examinations, the last on real or simulated parts; the VT simulator and practice tests help with preparation.
  • A vision examination, then certification signed by the employer's responsible Level III.

Newcomers can read NDT Level 1 training to see the whole path, and Philadelphia employers certifying several people should start with NDT training in Philadelphia or the statewide Pennsylvania NDT training page.

What the VT practical looks for. Candidates are usually handed welds or components with planted conditions and asked to measure undercut, reinforcement, misalignment and surface porosity with the right gauges, compare each against a named acceptance standard and write the result down. People rarely fail on spotting the obvious; they fail on measuring with the wrong tool, forgetting to record what they could not see, or writing an opinion where a measurement was required.

Credentials that get confused with VT certification. The ASNT NDT Level III in visual testing is an ASNT examination for people who write procedures and certify others. The AWS Certified Welding Inspector is a separate personal credential that many structural and pipeline contracts require for weld acceptance. Atlantis prepares candidates for the ASNT Level III examination through ASNT NDT Level III training; it does not train for CWI. A technician should ask which of these a job advert actually wants before enrolling in anything.

The Pennsylvania regime. The National Board lists Pennsylvania's Department of Labor and Industry, Boiler Division, as the state jurisdiction. Philadelphia does not appear as a separate member jurisdiction, unlike Chicago, New York City or Los Angeles, so which inspector covers a given boiler or vessel inside the city is confirmed with the department rather than assumed. Pennsylvania is also an NRC Agreement State, which matters when VT of a weld is paired with radiography: the radiography licence then comes from the state program.

VT on inspection jobs. On refining, pharmaceutical and manufacturing sites in the region, VT is the examination that decides where volumetric and surface methods go. A useful VT report names the acceptance document, records inaccessible areas separately from examined ones, and ties each photograph to a location so the next inspector can find the same spot.

For inspection, see the national visual testing service and the statewide Pennsylvania inspection services page. To ask about VT certification for a Philadelphia team, contact the training desk.
